candidates.title: LMCache load-back over-evicts from the independent FULL KV pool
candidates.snippet: With SGLang + LMCache on Qwen3-0.6B, limit the independent FULL pool to 8,192 slots and leave 3,840 free. Reload a 4,096-token prefix from LMCache. SGLang evicts 4,096 cached tokens even though it needs only 256 more slots.  In our reproduction, the next request had to reload its 256-token prefix from LMCache. Reclaiming only the shortfall kept that prefix on the GPU.
